observations: Yellow gas cylinder sitting on concrete floor
Cylinder has a metal valve assembly at the top
The top lid is open, showing the valve and the interior
The cylinder shows some surface wear and minor scuffing
Watermark 'HITHE TECHNOLOGIES' is visible across the center of the image
No brand name, capacity markings, or expiry date are visible on the cylinder in photo 0

claims.evidence: The photo shows a cylinder, but the capacity markings are not legible to determine the size.

claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak, the valve is new.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be expired or past its re-test date.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturing or expiry date stamped on the metal shroud or handle.

risks.risk: The valve may be faulty or leaking.
risks.proof: A video showing a soap bubble test on the valve while the cylinder is under pressure.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be empty or contain a different gas than specified.
risks.proof: A photo of the weight stamp on the shroud showing the current weight.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the weight stamp on the shroud to confirm the current weight.
Photo of the expiry or manufacturing date stamp on the cylinder shroud.
Photo of the valve assembly with a soap bubble test to check for leaks.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
